evidence: Official ForInvest SDK documentation exposes authenticated WebSocket and REST services, symbol definitions, bid/ask field subscriptions, depth and snapshot services.
The SDK exposes license metadata, indicating feed capabilities are entitlement-controlled.
Official SDK legal disclaimer says not to put the SDK into production use and directs users to contact the ForInvest sales team for credentials/password information.
No primary-source permanent-$0 automated/non-display U.S. consolidated National NBBO entitlement was found.
Midas publicly identifies Foreks as the data provider on some BIST/FX/gold web surfaces, but no primary source binds Midas U.S. mobile/Atlas realtime data specifically to Foreks.
reopen_condition: Primary-source documentation identifies a permanent-$0 production entitlement carrying consolidated U.S. National NBBO with scheduler-safe automated/non-display rights and exact quote/trade event timestamps.
